Name: Indoor Food and Water Bowls For Pets (AT)
Author: kezaraxoxo
Description:
[size=3]Now available with the original design, plus 17 new color options! ^.^[/size]

[size=3]I felt bad that my pets have no food, and cannot drink water when they're stuck inside during bad weather. So I changed that.

Download the file and extract it into your mods folder. Then purchase the paint bucket from Robin and use it on the (small) futan bears, and now your pets can have food and water inside! :)  the water bowl does not function like a pet bowl, you cannot manually fill it with the water can. It's just a normal piece of furniture.[/size]

Highly recommend using with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] so you can fully tweak their placement: having them right up against the wall, not having the two bowls touch each other, etc.

The pet bed shown in my pictures is from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10478]CP Pet Bed[/url] by aedenthorn, which can be used in combination with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10462]Custom Pet Beds[/url] by aedenthorn to have your pets actually sleep in their bed :)  I plan to make recolors of the pet bed as well at some point to give it some more color options.
